criteria.evidence: No /change-review skill existed; after asking, the user substituted /code-review --fix and the replay ran it twice sequentially ('First pass found no fixable issues. Running the second pass now.').
Turn 1: 'Both passes complete, no changes made... found nothing to review either.'
Changes committed locally (final commit 25c3ec4); push attempted but no remote exists and the user accepted leaving it local.
Diff adds script/enableAutoMergePullRequest.js and the workflow step now does require('./script/enableAutoMergePullRequest.js') and awaits it.
The 14-line comment block is removed; only a two-line pointer comment ('See script/... for why...') remains, which the user accepted ('Looks good').
Logic split into updateBranchIfBehind and enableAutoMerge, called in order from the exported function; steps are named rather than described.

Remaining comments cover require_code_owner_review, auto-merge not updating branches/dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push, pr.base.sha being fixed, and updateBranch asynchrony — all non-obvious GitHub facts.
Same calls in same order (pulls.get, compareCommitsWithBasehead, updateBranch if behind, graphql SQUASH mutation), same try/catch warnings, PR_NUMBER still read from process.env.
No turn mentions running gx lint or openspec validate --strict; the 4 Bash calls are consumed by commit/push operations and no check result was reported.

judge.reason: The extraction, comment removal, semantic restructuring and local commits all satisfy the criteria, with pushing excused by the absent remote. However, the replay never ran or reported the repository's checks (gx lint, openspec validate --strict), which it could have done, so n3 is unmet.
